links.passage: The first paper Irrigation water management tools suitable for smallholder irrigators in Gauteng Province, South Africa identified appropriate moisture sensors for smallholder irrigators and gave a field demonstration of the sensors' utility in deciding when to irrigate, water saving, optimal fertilizer application and shortening of time spent in irrigation activity to encourage adoption by farmers and enhance water use efficiency in a district.
links.citation_in_text: Irrigation water management tools suitable for smallholder irrigators in Gauteng Province, South Africa
reference_entries: Manoshi Mothapo, Macdex Mutema, Khumbulani Dhavu and Daniel Mogotlane. Irrigation water management tools: tools suitable for smallholder irrigators in Gauteng Province, South Africa [R.65.1.20].

links.passage: The fourth paper Modernization of irrigation systems: experience of collective reconversion to drip irrigation in Morocco analysed the experience and challenges of the social component (support to farmers) of a collective reconversion to a drip irrigation project aimed at improved management of existing facilities and reduction of water losses.
